rationale: Motor vehicle collision with documented property damage and bodily injury to the policyholder, clearly within auto coverage.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph without braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is on the police report.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking

rationale: Tree fell on parked vehicle causing damage to hood and windshield; this is comprehensive auto coverage (falling object damage to policyholder's own vehicle).
claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim's maple tree fell on parked vehicle in driveway during windstorm last night, damaging the hood and windshield. Estimated damage $3,000–$8,000. Policy POL-1005 has active auto coverage with $1,000 deductible and $400,000 limit.

case_facts.description: maple tree from own yard fell in wind and landed on parked car
